description: This file contains unit tests for stream filtering functionality with Azure Queue streaming providers within the Orleans framework. It defines a test class 'AQStreamFilteringTests' that sets up test fixtures, Azure Queue stream provider configuration, and multiple test cases for filtering behavior.
